title: Fairness Testing: A Comprehensive Survey and Analysis of Trends
benchmark_measurement: Bias detection related to religious identity, primarily in the context of toxicity detection and language generation.
findings: The survey identifies religion as a sensitive attribute considered in the fairness testing literature. However, it is a less frequently studied attribute compared to sex/gender, race, and age, appearing in only 3 of the 100 surveyed papers. Datasets like 'Wikipedia comments', 'Jigsaw Comments', 'BOLD', and 'BiasAsker' are cited as resources for testing biases related to religion.
